_comment: Perk adapter: Ascension by Darenii - 1.0.1 (an Adamant 5 Destruction addon), Ascension 2 1.0.4 (its
own Custom Skills tree) and Ascension - Adamant 6 Patch v2 (Adamant 6's Elementalist). All three ask
one keyword on Destruction spells: Raw Power and Execution for unaspected damage, Deflection and
Elementalist beside fire, frost and shock. The keyword is injected into Update.esm's FormID range,
and Apostasy Framework injects the same FormID as APO_MagicDamageUnspecified, so the line names it
by FormID (keywordForm); in game it takes whatever name the loaded form carries.
What unaspected means is Darenii's: Deflection lists fire, frost, shock, poison, vampire drain and
this one as the six kinds of Destruction damage, and Darenii's own spell packs carry it on arcane,
shadow, blood, necrotic and nature damage (Arcane, Abyss, Bloodmoon, Desecration, Natura) but not on
shock, sun or poison (Arclight, Lunaris, Necrom). So: Destruction damage to health that none of the
other five keywords claims, with a librarian element outside them.
Magic Mantle and Destructive Barrier read MagicCloak, which vanilla.json gives.

adapters.why: unaspected Destruction damage: not fire, frost, shock, poison, sun or a vampire drain
